bio.text: Mary Gay Scanlon represents Pennsylvania's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House; she was first sworn in on November 13, 2018, after a special election.
She serves on the Rules and Judiciary committees and was previously national pro bono counsel at a major law firm, an attorney at the Education Law Center, and president of her local school board.
Scanlon graduated from Colgate University and the University of Pennsylvania Law School and lives in Swarthmore.
